marks.gloss_en: but they were tevulei yom [at the giving of the Torah]!
Abaye bar Ravin and Rav Chanina bar Avin both said: ניתנה תורה לטבול יום (= p_nitna_torah_litvul_yom; Mareimar: ראויה)
Abaye bar Ravin and Rav Chanina bar Avin: the Torah was given to tevulei yom
'every garment and every hide on which there is semen' -- excluding foul semen; מאי לאו שפירשה מן האיש? -- so semen from a man can be foul, and not impure, while still moist
these are R' Yishmael's and R' Akiva's words; but the Sages say six full onot are required
R' Yitzchak: 'from the first I did not speak in secret' (Isa 48:16) -- [against receiving the Torah at twilight]
'this' here ('on this day they came to the Sinai desert', Ex 19:1) and 'this' there ('this month shall be to you the head of months', Ex 12:2): as there Rosh Chodesh, so here Rosh Chodesh
'remember' here ('remember the Shabbat day', Ex 20:8) and 'remember' there ('remember this day', Ex 13:3): as there on the very day, so here on the very day [of Shabbat]
on the sixth of the month [Sivan] the Ten Commandments were given to Israel
